verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a bulk export, a download-all-data feature, open export formats, or an account-exit process. The public REST API (with an OpenAPI spec) and the MCP server are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, not an export capability, and cloud storage of digitized mail is not an export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
